discrepancies.target: Table 2 inner effective-force increment versus Eqs. (6)-(8)
discrepancies.observation: The original Table 2 visibly reports fS=471 N/m, inner ΔS=153 N/m and outer ΔS=312 N/m. The published component values sum to 465 N/m, while Eqs. (6)-(8) with the published stiffnesses reproduce about 158.8 N/m and 312.2 N/m and close exactly to 471 N/m.
discrepancies.engineering_interpretation: This is a source-confirmed internal published-reference mismatch. A typographical error of 153 versus 159 N/m is plausible because 159+312=471 and Eq. (6) gives 158.8 N/m, but that explanation remains unconfirmed without an erratum or author clarification.
closure_requirements: Retain the visually confirmed Table 2 values exactly as published.
Retain the independent Eqs. (6)-(8) reproduction separately.
Seek an erratum, author clarification, or other provenance before asserting that 153 is a typographical error.
Do not tune source inputs to force the published component value.

discrepancies.target: Figure 10 moment units in source paragraph versus plotted axis
discrepancies.observation: The source paragraph states approximately 300 MNm for the inner pipe and 850 MNm for the outer pipe, while Figure 10 labels the y-axis as Moment [kNm] and displays corresponding numerical levels on a 0-1000 scale.
discrepancies.engineering_interpretation: This is a source-internal unit mismatch of three orders of magnitude if the paragraph units are interpreted literally. The figure axis and plotted scale are consistent with kNm, but EngiProof does not silently correct the paragraph without an erratum or author clarification.
closure_requirements: Retain the paragraph and axis units exactly as published.
Do not silently relabel MNm as kNm.
Seek an erratum, author clarification, or other provenance before closure.

limitations: Table 2 contains a source-confirmed internal mismatch: 153+312=465 N/m whereas fS=471 N/m and Eqs. (6)-(8) reproduce the total 471 N/m.
Figure 10 contains a source-internal unit mismatch: the paragraph reports approximately 300/850 MNm while the plotted axis is Moment [kNm].
DOI is externally confirmed but was not found in extracted PDF text; source-identity audit remains REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than conflict.
This reproduction covers axial stiffness/load-sharing mechanics only; no global-buckling FE model is reproduced.

Eq. (10) is callable, but direct reproduction of the 1.305 m full-bonding end expansion is conditional because S0_total cannot be independently reconstructed from explicit numerical source inputs without added assumptions.
Figures 8-10 are source observations only; no curve digitization, global-buckling FE recreation or nonlinear local FE reproduction is claimed.
